description:
The regular bar owner at a favorite local pub turns out to be a former legendary hunter. Ordinary patrons are stunned as their unassuming “boss” reveals overwhelming strength and skills that go far beyond the typical bartender. The story unfolds as this retired powerhouse navigates life behind the bar, sometimes confronting threats from their old hunter days and protecting the establishment (and its guests) in ways only a true legend could—blurring the line between peaceful civilian life and the hidden world of superhuman hunters.

**Original Webtoon:**   
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=845024), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=13398288)
